Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Cabernet Slatted 2-Drawer Cabinet, 23.6"W, Ash
Materials: stone
23.6”W x 15.7”D x 31.7”H Solid ash frame and legs are complemented by hardwood doors with ash veneer A handsome piece that can anchor a modern, rustic or transitional style room Can be a standalone piece in a hallway or a side table in a living room or bedroom. Assembly in 15 minutes or less. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This simple, beautifully designed 2-drawer cabinet can double as a compact side table next to a sofa or bed, providing storage space as well as a handsome complement to a modern, transitional or rustic decor. Solid ash accents add visual interest.
